content: Hello, I am an Algebraic Topology Ph.D. student and have recently become very interested in formalizing mathematics in Lean4 and want to contribute to the formalization efforts. I have been reading on how topology has been cast using Filters in mathlib to make integration easier. I have also been reading about the condensed set reformulation of a topological space to aid in unifying fields. I had a question on Algebraic Topology. Is the current trend to use Condensed sets to formalize Algebraic Topology results or is that left for the Algebraic Geometry results?
